note: Douglas County Forestry park in the village of Solon Springs, with a swimming beach on Upper St. Croix Lake and an amphitheater for summer Music in the Park concerts. The campground loop sits in pines west of the day-use area, a few hundred meters from the lake. --Claude
summary: Douglas County campgrounds page, the (2011) park brochure/map, the PremierCampground page and imagery read. $20-30 + $5 reservation fee, extra $2 per person past 5; water + electric at 23 sites (amperage not stated now); showers/flush/dump; season opens two Fridays before Memorial Day (05-21 in 2027); booking via PremierCampground from Feb 1, unreserved sites FCFS. Not waterfront kept. Site count inconsistent on the county page.
flags: SITE COUNT: county page says '29 total sites: 23 with electrical and water hook-ups and, 9 non-electric' (23 + 9 = 32); stored count 32 left. The 2011 brochure map numbers sites 1-24 plus '4 RV Campsites (no electricity)' (28). Unresolved.

AMPERAGE unsourced: the current page gives no amperage; the 2011 brochure said '13 drive-in electrical sites with 50-amp service', since superseded by 23 electric/water sites. hookups.electric left unset.
PHONE old -> new: 715-378-2219 -> 715-378-2027. The county page now says 'Any questions please call (715) 378-2027'; 378-2219 is the Forestry Department number from the 2011 brochure.
SEASON closes not set: 'to Monday after Labor Day' could be read as Labor Day itself (Sept 6, 2027) or the following Monday (Sept 13); left for the reviewer.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Map and imagery put the campground loop in woods ~200-300 m west of the Upper St. Croix Lake shore and beach (loop centroid ~46.3499,-91.8175).
PIN 46.3509,-91.8164 is on the park road by the shower building, ~140 m NE of the loop: fine. WEBSITE (county page + PremierCampground) confirmed. Inclusion evidence current.
